content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

This infrastructure is more than just a GitHub Pages site - it's a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows creators to host, sell, and deliver digital products without relying on Stripe or other payment processors. By using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, NOWPayments for crypto payments, and Supabase for order storage, creators can build a fully operational online store without giving up control or paying platform fees. This architecture is built for digital creators who want to own their infrastructure and avoid recurring subscription costs.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here's how it works: GitHub Pages hosts your digital product store, while Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, automating tasks like order processing and product delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, converting prices in USD at transaction time and charging a flat 0.5% fee. Supabase stores orders, ensuring that all transactions are secure and tamper-proof. By combining these components, creators can build a robust digital commerce infrastructure that's entirely under their control.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators who want to sell ebooks, courses, software, and other digital products without relying on Stripe or other payment processors. Whether you're an author, educator, or developer, this architecture allows you to build a fully operational online store without giving up control or paying platform fees. By using NOWPayments for crypto payments, you can even sell digital downloads in USDT, Bitcoin, or other cryptocurrencies without giving up 10% to Gumroad or Payhip.
Now you can sell ebooks, courses, and software without giving up control or paying platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure are GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, NOWPayments, and Supabase. GitHub Pages provides hosting for your digital product store, while Cloudflare Workers automate backend logic and tasks like order processing. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, charging a flat 0.5% fee and converting prices in USD at transaction time. Supabase stores orders, ensuring that all transactions are secure and tamper-proof. By combining these components, creators can build a robust digital commerce infrastructure that's entirely under their control.

To deploy this infrastructure today, start by choosing a digital product to sell - whether it's an ebook, course, software, or other digital download. Then, create a GitHub Pages site to host your product store, using Cloudflare Workers to automate backend logic and tasks like order processing. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payments and Supabase for order storage. Frequently Asked Questions
How do I get started with NOWPayments?

To get started with NOWPayments, simply sign up for an account and connect your cryptocurrency wallet. You can then integrate NOWPayments with your GitHub Pages site using Cloudflare Workers and Supabase for order storage.
Can I sell digital downloads in multiple cryptocurrencies?

Yes, with NOWPayments, you can sell digital downloads in multiple cryptocurrencies, including USDT, Bitcoin, and others. Simply integrate NOWPayments with your GitHub Pages site and choose the cryptocurrency you want to use for each sale.
How do I automate backend logic with Cloudflare Workers?

To automate backend logic with Cloudflare Workers, create a new Cloudflare Worker and write code to handle tasks like order processing and product delivery. You can then integrate this worker with your GitHub Pages site and use NOWPayments for crypto payments.

No, this infrastructure is designed specifically for digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and software. If you want to sell physical products, you will need to use a different infrastructure.
